 Print 'Scene' box office collection day 4. Suriya and Jithu Madhavan's 'Scene' is continuing its successful theatrical run, with the film approaching a major worldwide box-office milestone. The film marks the first collaboration between Suriya and director Jithu Madhavan. The Tamil version remained the biggest contributor to the film's domestic earnings. It collected Rs 17.85 cr on Monday, while the Telugu version added Rs 3.40 cr. The combined India net collection now stands at Rs 84.40 cr, with the domestic gross reaching Rs 98.05 cr. The film also recorded a strong overseas performance, taking its international gross to Rs 51.50 cr. 'Scene' approaches Rs 150 cr worldwide
 According to Sacnilk, 'Scene' collected Rs 21.25 cr net in India on Monday through 5,801 shows. This represented a 10.1% decline compared with its previous day's collection of Rs 23.65 cr. Despite the dip, the film continued to attract audiences across its theatrical markets. The movie earned Rs 5 cr from overseas markets on its fourth day. This took its cumulative international gross to Rs 51.50 cr. When combined with its domestic earnings, the worldwide collection reached Rs 149.55 cr. Ticket sales also reflected the film's continued audience interest. An estimated 15,78,355 tickets were sold on Monday. The total number of tickets sold during its four-day run has reached 62,78,409. Tamil version dominates the domestic collection
 The Tamil version accounted for 84% of the day's India net collection. It earned Rs 17.85 cr from 4,378 shows, recording an occupancy of 72.1%. The Telugu version contributed the remaining share, collecting Rs 3.40 cr through 1,423 shows at 47% occupancy. The difference between the two versions is also visible in their cumulative domestic earnings. The Tamil release has contributed Rs 70 cr to the total India net collection, accounting for 82.9%. The Telugu version has added Rs 14.40 cr, representing the remaining 17.1%. Theatre occupancy remains encouraging
 The Tamil version registered an overall occupancy of 77.04% on Monday. Morning shows recorded 63.62%, while afternoon screenings improved to 80.85%. Evening shows registered 82.38%, and night shows maintained an occupancy of 81.31%. The Telugu version recorded an overall occupancy of 45.84%. Its morning shows registered 29.82%, followed by 52.45% in the afternoon. Evening and night screenings recorded occupancies of 46.18% and 51.45%, respectively. Tamil Nadu leads the state-wise collections
 Tamil Nadu remained the biggest contributor in the state-wise gross collection report. The state earned Rs 14.65 cr on Monday, accounting for 59.3% of the tracked total. Andhra Pradesh and Telangana together contributed Rs 4.10 cr. Karnataka added Rs 2.70 cr, while Kerala recorded Rs 2.75 cr. The remaining Indian markets contributed Rs 0.50 cr. These regions together generated a tracked gross collection of Rs 24.70 cr on the day. Suriya's police officer faces an unresolved mystery
 'Scene' features Suriya as Inbaraj, an eccentric police officer who is forced to reopen a mysterious case from his past. The investigation brings him into contact with a chaotic and troublesome team. Together, they must work through the complications surrounding the unfinished case. The film brings Suriya and Jithu Madhavan together for the first time. Naslen also plays a key role in the story, along with Nazriya Nazim. DISCLAIMER: The box office numbers and the data in this article are compiled from public and industry sources. All figures are approximate unless explicitly mentioned, offering a fair representation of the movie's box office performance. These totals may change as official studio data is updated or as additional international market reports are finalized. This data is provided by us for informational and entertainment purposes only.
